Rita: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing an adaptive epoch-credit ledger + cheap probe tokens as an alternative to soft-lease. Aim: fast edge admission, central fairness, and easier abuse signals. Thoughts?

Sam: How do credits reconcile? central authoritative or edges hold transient view?

Rita: Edges keep a transient local credit for O(10ms) admit. Central ledger reconciles per-epoch (10s) and issues corrective adjustments. Local credits are conservative.

Jess: Two concerns: replay/parallel drains across edges, and penalty shaping for repeats.

Kai: Mitigations: client-scoped probe tokens + randomized epoch offsets per-client-subnet to complicate parallel replay. Penalty = polynomial growth (penalty ~ burst^1.5) so sustained abuse escalates.

Rita: Config sketch: ```epoch_secs=10; base_multiplier=1.0; burst_multiplier=3.0; probe_pct=0.005; penalty_exponent=1.5; fallback=small-v1; unknown_client_policy=soft-queue``` Probes carry signed nonces; failed attribution -> suspicious score down.

Sam: Pseudocode for admission?

Rita: 1) if local_credit >= cost_estimate -> allow; 2) else if is_probe and probe_quota>0 -> allow + tag; 3) else if central_recent_estimate>=cost_estimate -> allow and decrement soft credit; 4) else -> fallback model or queue with backoff.

Jess: Telemetry hooks required: estimated_cost should use model, tokens, early-stop. Histogram estimated_vs_actual tokens for tuning. Also track fairness index and suspicious_rate.

Kai: Add reputation circuit: below threshold -> drop probes, strict per-request admission, surface incident. Origin-fuzzing + tunable penalty_exponent via remote config.

ops-bot: Deployment queued: canary=5% -> regions: edge-us-east-1, edge-eu-west-1. CI: green ✅

Jess: I'll own synthetic tests: mixed workload with attack shapes (parallel replay, short burst, long burst, big payload, probe evasion, model switch). Measure fairness index, false positive rate, p95/p99 latency.

Rita: Rollout plan: canary 5% (2 regions) -> monitor fairness & suspicious rate -> 25% if suspicious < 0.1% (adjust penalty_exponent up if needed) -> full. Need signoffs: Sam (perf), Jess (tests), Kai (security).

Kai: I can sign off if origin fuzzing + reputation breaker are included.

Rita: I'll update RFC and open canary PR after test infra is ready. :rocket:
